hosts.note: WisDOT's camera stream servers (cctv1.dot.wi.gov and the like): core/traffic Ibi511.kt keeps a 511WI camera's https playlist link (https://cctv<n>.dot.wi.gov/rtplive/<camera>/playlist.m3u8) only when its host ends in this suffix. When a camera card opens, the card fetches that playlist, the media playlist it names and the newest few-second segment through NetworkGate.get, and decodes one frame on the phone (core/traffic Hls.kt, feature/explore TrafficCameraCard.kt). The links name the camera, never the viewer. Gated by NetworkFeature.TRAFFIC_511WI (Settings > Live data, off by default).

core/network GitHubReleases.isAllowed accepts any https host ending .githubusercontent.com (where GitHub redirects release asset downloads, e.g. objects.githubusercontent.com), checked on every redirect hop. Used for map pack downloads (NetworkFeature.PACK_DOWNLOADS, on by default) and new app versions (NetworkFeature.APP_UPDATES, off by default); every such request runs inside NetworkGate.request(feature), so the feature toggle gates it. The token goes to api.github.com only, never to this host. Also the weather forecast pack (NetworkFeature.WEATHER, off by default): core/weather GitHubForecastSource reads the "weather" pre-release (GitHubReleases.byTag) and its forecast-ny.json.gz, the same file for every phone, at most hourly.

Suffix literal in org/maplibre/android/http/NativeHttpRequest (MapLibre Native's HTTP request class; Mapbox host checks inherited from its Mapbox lineage, like mapbox.cn). Not contacted by app code: the style is bundled and tiles are pmtiles://file://. Every request in the app's own code still goes through core/network NetworkGate; MapLibre's own client is not behind it and is unused.

When a camera card opens, the card fetches that playlist, the media playlist it names and the newest few-second segment through NetworkGate.get, and decodes one frame on the phone (core/traffic Hls.kt, feature/explore TrafficCameraCard.kt). The links name the camera, never the viewer. Gated by NetworkFeature.TRAFFIC_CHART_MD (Settings > Live data, off by default).

KDOT's Skyline camera servers (kdot-sfs2.us-east-1.skyvdn.com and the like): core/traffic CarsStates.kt keeps a Kansas camera's still on a host ending in this; fetched through NetworkGate.get when its card opens; names the camera, never the viewer. Gated by NetworkFeature.TRAFFIC_KANDRIVE (Settings > Live data, off by default).

511WI (WisDOT's 511, built by IBI Group like 511PA): core/traffic Ibi511.kt (Ibi511.WI) fetches the site's own map layers (/map/mapIcons/Incidents, Closures, Construction and MessageSigns: every item's position) and list pages (/List/GetData/Incidents, Closures, traffic, MessageSigns and Cameras, 100 rows a page), the same requests 511wi.gov's map and list pages make. The whole state every time, no key and nothing about the user's location, search or route. Camera stills are the list's own image links (/map/Cctv/<image id>), fetched through NetworkGate.get when a camera card opens. Gated by NetworkFeature.TRAFFIC_511WI (Settings > Live data, off by default).

511NY's public collections, the ones 511ny.org's own map reads since its October 2026 move to the CARS platform: core/traffic FiveElevenNyCars.kt fetches /events/map-features (incidents, closures, construction, each with the site's own query), /signs/map-features and /cameras/map-features, and /hash for each to skip unchanged ones. The whole state every time, no key and nothing about the user's location, search or route. Gated by NetworkFeature.TRAFFIC_511NY (Settings > Live data, off by default). Camera stills are the feed's videoPreviewUrl (seen on public.carsprogram.org), passed to NetworkGate.get under the same toggle when a camera card opens, so that host is not in this baseline.
MTA subway, LIRR, Metro-North and alert realtime feeds: core/transit TransitRealtime.kt. Gated by NetworkFeature.TRANSIT_REALTIME (off by default).

EIA weekly gas price: core/routing GasPrices.kt. Gated by NetworkFeature.GAS_PRICES (Settings > Driving, off by default, user-entered key). The request carries the state chosen in Settings, not the location.

National Weather Service alerts: core/weather NwsAlerts.kt fetches /alerts/active?area=NY,NJ,CT,PA,MD,DE,DC (every active alert in every covered state, one request) and WeatherFeed reads the shapes of the /zones/ that alerts name (only zones named by those alerts, the same for every phone). No key, nothing about the user's location, search or route. Gated by NetworkFeature.WEATHER (Settings > Live data, off by default).

Strings inside the MapLibre Android SDK (attribution and feedback links, Mapbox host checks inherited from its Mapbox lineage). App code never uses them: the map style is bundled (assets/light.json, dark.json) and tiles come from pmtiles://file:// on the phone.

Current weather: core/weather Metar.URLS, the NWS Aviation Weather Center's latest METAR of every reporting station in each covered state (ids=@NY, @NJ, @CT, @PA, @MD, @DE; one request per state, the API takes one state a request), the same for every phone. Drawn as temperature badges on the weather layer and as the nearest station's conditions on a place card, worked out on the phone. No key, nothing about the user's location, search or route. Gated by NetworkFeature.WEATHER (Settings > Live data, off by default).

Maryland's CHART (MDOT SHA's traffic centre): core/traffic MarylandChart.kt fetches the exports CHART's own traffic map reads, /CHARTExportClientService/getEventMapDataJSON.do, getDMSMapDataJSON.do and getCameraMapDataJSON.do: the events, message signs and cameras of the whole state, every time, no key and nothing about the user's location, search or route. Gated by NetworkFeature.TRAFFIC_CHART_MD (Settings > Live data, off by default).

CTroads (CTDOT's 511, built by IBI Group like 511PA): core/traffic Ibi511.kt (Ibi511.CT) fetches the site's own map layers (/map/mapIcons/Incidents, Closures, Construction and MessageSigns: every item's position) and list pages (/List/GetData/Incidents, Closures, Construction, MessageSigns and Cameras, 100 rows a page), the same requests ctroads.org's map and list pages make. The whole state every time, no key and nothing about the user's location, search or route. Camera stills are the list's own image links (/map/Cctv/<image id>), fetched through NetworkGate.get when a camera card opens. Gated by NetworkFeature.TRAFFIC_CTROADS (Settings > Live data, off by default).
NYC DOT traffic speeds: core/traffic NycDotSpeeds.kt. Gated by NetworkFeature.TRAFFIC_NYC_DOT (off by default).

NOAA radar: core/weather Radar.URL, one WMS GetMap of MRMS base reflectivity over a fixed box around every covered state in EPSG:3857, the same picture for every phone, drawn as the map's weather layer. No key, nothing about the user's location or the map area viewed. Gated by NetworkFeature.WEATHER (Settings > Live data, off by default).

South Dakota's SD511 (Iteris) CDN: core/traffic SouthDakota.kt fetches the GeoJSON files its own map reads, /geojson/icons/metadata/icons.road-work, incidents-accidents, restriction, obstructions and scheduled-events (the events) and icons.cameras and icons.rwis (camera sites), the whole state every time, no key and nothing about the user's location, search or route; a camera's still (https://sd.cdn.iteris-atis.com/camera_images/<site>/<view>/latest.jpg) is kept only on this host and fetched through NetworkGate.get when its card opens. Gated by NetworkFeature.TRAFFIC_SD511 (Settings > Live data, off by default).

Delaware's DelDOT (its Transportation Management Center): core/traffic DelDot.kt fetches the files DelDOT's own traffic map reads, /json/advisory.json, vmsg-vms.json and videocamera.json: the advisories, message signs and cameras of the whole state, every time, no key and nothing about the user's location, search or route. Gated by NetworkFeature.TRAFFIC_DELDOT (Settings > Live data, off by default).

Illinois' Travel Midwest (the Gateway Traveler Information System of IDOT and the Illinois Tollway): core/traffic TravelMidwest.kt posts `{}` (the only request the site answers; NetworkGate.post) to the GeoJSON files its own map reads, /lmiga/incidentMap.json, constructionMap.json?type=lines, cameraMap.json and dmsMap.json: the incidents, road work, cameras and message signs of the whole state, every time, no key and nothing about the user's location, search or route. Gated by NetworkFeature.TRAFFIC_TRAVEL_MIDWEST (Settings > Live data, off by default).

Kansas's 511 site: core/traffic CarsStates.kt posts the fixed GraphQL document CarsStates.eventsQuery (the site's own mapFeaturesQuery for its incidents, closures, construction and road reports layers over a fixed box around the whole state) to /api/graphql through NetworkGate.post, every time the same bytes, no key and nothing about the user. Gated by NetworkFeature.TRAFFIC_KANDRIVE (Settings > Live data, off by default).

Valhalla's httpd.service.listen setting (tcp://*:8002) in its bundled default configuration (com/valhalla/valhalla/default.json) and the matching default in valhalla-models-config. When a camera card opens, the card fetches that playlist, the media playlist it names and the newest few-second segment through NetworkGate.get, and decodes one frame on the phone (core/traffic Hls.kt, feature/explore TrafficCameraCard.kt). The links name the camera, never the viewer. Gated by NetworkFeature.TRAFFIC_DELDOT (Settings > Live data, off by default).
